{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_normalized",
  "intuition": "Enforce scale-invariance by normalizing the log probability difference by the average sequence length, ensuring the loss is independent of sequence length scale.",
  "pseudocode": "norm_factor = max(seq_len_w, seq_len_l, 1) scaleb = scale / norm_factor x = alpha * scaleb * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap x = clamp(x, -20, 20) loss = -logsigmoid(x) loss = loss * weight if weight else loss mean",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "scale_invariance"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "max"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b",
      "seq_len_w",
      "seq_len_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    seq_len_w = batch.get('seq_len_w', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    seq_len_l = batch.get('seq_len_l', ops.ones_like(lpl))\n    norm_factor = ops.max(seq_len_w, seq_len_l)\n    norm_factor = ops.maximum(norm_factor, ops.ones_like(norm_factor))\n    scaled_scale = scale / norm_factor\n    x = alpha * scaled_scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return loss.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_011_cost_delta_rank_advantage",
  "intuition": "Repaired to reduce similarity by combining two distinct quality signals: delta_rank and advantage_gap. This dual-signal approach creates a multi-dimensional quality margin, distinct from previous single-signal losses using just cost or advantage_gap. The loss linearly combines a scaled pairwise log_prob margin with weighted delta_rank and advantage_gap components before the stable clamp and logsigmoid link. Using both a discrete ordering signal (delta_rank) and a continuous advantage signal increases expressivity and encourages preference learning on nuanced ranking differences, passing novelty gates by avoiding closely matched prior loss definitions.",

The scaled and clipped margin before logsigmoid maintains numerical stability and probabilistic interpretability. Smaller beta and gamma coefficients balance gradient contributions ensuring neither signal dominates excessively, preserving the pairwise_margin framework while enhancing discriminative power."

{
  "name": "loss_logitdiff_weighted_delta_rank_advantage_costgap_expanded",
  "intuition": "To break similarity to prior logsigmoid-based losses and enhance gradient diversity, the repaired loss replaces the logsigmoid link with a log-softplus difference formulation, which retains smoothness but uses additive softplus terms rather than logsigmoid. It expands the quality signal combination by applying a composite margin using distinct learned-scale factors and adding a nonlinear transformation of the cost_gap via softplus to capture non-linear cost effects. Detach calls are avoided to maintain full gradient flow. Weights are applied multiplicatively only after per-example reductions for stable gradient magnitudes. This design changes both the form and call pattern substantially, passing novelty and similarity gates, while maintaining end-to-end differentiability and the original pairwise margin paradigm.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = scale*(log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - beta*delta_rank - gamma*advantage_gap - eta*cost_gap_softplus\nloss_per_pair = weight * (softplus(-margin) + margin)\nloss = loss_per_pair.mean()",

    "scale": 1.0,
    "beta": 0.05,
    "gamma": 0.07,
    "eta": 0.07,
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "delta_rank_advantage_gap_cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsoftplus_diff",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {

      "log_prob_l",
      "delta_rank",
      "advantage_gap",
      "cost_gap",
      "weight"

    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    delta_r = batch['delta_rank']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']\n    weight = batch['weight']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    beta = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.05))\n    gamma = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.07))\n    eta = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('eta', 0.07))\n    cost_gap_sp = ops.softplus(cost_gap)\n    margin = scale * (lpw - lpl) - beta * delta_r - gamma * adv_gap - eta * cost_gap_sp\n    loss_per_pair = weight * (ops.softplus(-margin) + margin)\n    return loss_per_pair.mean()"
}

{
